author: _Phyre
body:
Your minecraft username(most recent name if changed) : Phyre / ScavFlexesToBrunoMars (TS)
The reason you were temp-banned/banned : Apparrently "Sending Keyloggers to others" (http://imgur.com/N7K3kDU)
Why you should be unbanned from the server.
 1) The link I gave out was not a keylogger, it was a fake and madeup web adress that doesn't even exsists.
 2) When I asked for proof that this was a keylogger, there was no response, as if there were none, and I was banned correctly for no reason.
 3) Here is the proof showing you that this is not a keylogger what so ever: http://gyazo.com/f0b5c8f95b16383f29b240043f61f4cf // I tried multiple times to visit the site, it wouldn't let me go.
 
 Now, I want to add one more thing. If this is a positive ban. Please provide evidence. But I really doubt it since my counter-proof pretty much defeats the purpose.
 
-Thank you!
